title: I just released the first playable alpha of Wreck Riot, my Twisted Metal-inspired car combat game!
author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on **Wreck Riot**, a 3D arcade vehicular combat game built in Godot with AI assistance, and the first public alpha is finally live!

You can drive weaponized cars, fire missiles, fight AI opponents, and smash through destructible environments.

The game currently features three vehicles — Inferno, Viper, and Razorback — with more content planned.

**🎮 Play free in your browser (Chrome/Edge):**

[https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot](https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot)

I'd love some feedback on the driving, weapons, destruction, and overall gameplay. It's still an early alpha, so your suggestions would mean a lot!

Thanks for checking it out! 🔥

replies.author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
replies.body:
Hey! Just wanted to come back and personally thank you for your feedback on Wreck Riot! 🙌

You mentioned having trouble with the driver naming and mobile controls, so I went ahead and worked on fixing those issues.

I'm happy to announce that **Wreck Riot Alpha V1.5 is now live with mobile touchscreen support!** 📱🚗

I fixed the driver naming issue, added a new joystick that handles steering, acceleration, and reversing, and improved the touchscreen combat controls. I also added automatic repair pads!

I've tested the new update on my Samsung Galaxy S23, and everything is running smoothly so far.

Your feedback genuinely helped push mobile support forward much sooner than I originally planned, so thank you!

If you get a chance to try the updated version, I'd love to hear what you think.

🎮 [https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot](https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot)

Thanks again for helping make Wreck Riot better! 🔥
